name: CampaignBars – Announcement & Notification Bars
author: Plugins.shop

sections.description:
Share offers, updates, deadlines and coupons without theme edits. Sticky top or fixed bottom. Draft, preview, publish; one eligible bar appears at a time.

Free, not a trial: unlimited campaigns; no account, API key, paid service, WooCommerce, time limit or forced public branding.

Try the Free and Pro demos

Try the Free demo | Try the Pro demo

Fictional data, not your site. Pro is a separate paid add-on, not included in Free.

Included in Free

  • Design: templates, colors, buttons, offsets, shorter mobile text.
  • Countdown: fixed deadline, not visitor-specific evergreen timers.
  • Coupons: copy codes; no creation, validation or application.
  • Targeting: page/page-type, device and login rules; exclusions win. Checkout excluded by default.
  • Scheduling: site-timezone start/end dates, dismissal, once-per-session display.
  • Preview: separate drafts, expiring publisher-only real-page previews and an illustrative editor preview.
  • Management: search/filter/duplicate, pause/resume, trash recovery, 20 draft-restored revisions. Stale saves rejected.
  • Local reports: optional views/clicks, last-30-days CSV. Off by default; configure consent first.

Editors gain no automatic publishing permission. Hideable Pro examples are fictional; focus/preview preferences are per browser/user. More plugins lists 16 companions locally, without auto-install.

Optional Pro add-on

Explore Pro | Compare plans

Paid Pro adds WooCommerce shipping progress using store rules, eligible coupon application, purchase attribution and advanced campaign tools. Free examples activate none of these; attribution does not prove extra sales.

Local Pro needs no key; eligible licences control private downloads/updates. Install Free before matching Pro.

By Plugins.shop

Made by Plugins.shop. Optional companion tools are available in the plugin’s More plugins page; none are installed automatically.

Useful alongside CampaignBars

  • KillerConversions – enquiry forms: Send visitors from a campaign button to a contact, quote or enquiry form.
  • ClickClue – session replay: Review consented visits to the pages your campaigns link to.
  • OrderFloor – order minimums and quantity rules: Set purchasing requirements that your announcement bars explain. Requires WooCommerce.

Separate, optional plugins by Plugins.shop. Free editions are available; none is required or installed automatically.

External services and APIs

Free makes no external API/licence/update calls or script/font/image/analytics requests. WordPress core handles directory/update/translation requests.

Your site’s campaign-bars/v1 editor REST API handles campaigns/settings/reports/exports/recovery/previews/diagnostics, using WordPress cookies, REST nonce and route-specific capabilities.

Local wp-admin/admin-ajax.php handles campaignbars_discover (assets) and campaignbars_resolve (page ID/type, signed context, device, utm_campaign, session seen/dismissed keys). Checks repeat on visible/cached pages without campaigns/measurement too. If measurement/configured consent allow, campaignbars_event sends a signed campaign/publication token, view/click type and consent flag for local counters.

Consent connections read locally; no service installed/contacted:

  • WP Consent API: reads wp_has_consent(‘statistics’), recorded statistics choice and change events. Availability alone grants no consent.
  • Cookiebot: reads installed Cookiebot.hasResponse, Cookiebot.consent.statistics and consent events. Configure separately; terms and privacy.
  • Custom: set window.CampaignBarsAnalyticsConsent or dispatch CampaignBarsConsent with detail: {analytics: true}, false on withdrawal. Local JavaScript, not a service.

Clicked links make browser requests: website privacy, terms. More plugins opens without remote requests; its product links open new tabs under Plugins.shop privacy.

Privacy and data

Measurement defaults off, consent requirement on. Disabling that requirement permits counting without consent. Neither edition guarantees legal compliance.

sessionStorage cbars: keys retain seen/dismissed state independently of analytics consent. Free sets no visitor tracking cookie; analytics tables contain no names/emails/IPs. Servers/other software may process IPs, headers and logs.

Aggregates store date, campaign/variant, metric, reporting bucket and quantity; deduplication stores a hash/timestamp. Daily WP-Cron targets 90 site-calendar days of aggregates and one day of event hashes; delays/deactivation can retain data longer. Campaigns, settings, editor user IDs and revisions remain until removed, not just 90 days.

Authorized CSV/JSON exports/backups have separate retention. No email-based aggregate exporter/eraser. Privacy suggestions appear in WordPress’s Privacy Policy Guide.

Deactivation/uninstall preserve data by default. Opt-in delete-data removes Free campaigns, revisions, report/event tables, options and capabilities on Free uninstall, not WooCommerce orders/Pro attribution, logs, backups or browser data. Pro documents its extra cookies, order metadata and removal separately.

Source and license

Readable PHP/JS/CSS, no build. WordPress supplies wp-i18n/dependencies. POT, no translations. Slug/text domain: campaignbars-announcement-manager. No third-party runtime library/remote code loader. Logos: assets/collection/SOURCES.txt. GPL-2.0-or-later: LICENSE.txt.
sections.installation:
1. Install/activate via Plugins > Add New or upload the Free ZIP.
  2. Choose a template; edit message, button, audience and dates.
  3. Save draft, check preview/visibility, publish.
  4. Configure measurement/consent in Settings. Not a consent banner; the private accept/revoke test grants no consent and records no measurements.
  5. Clear page/CDN caches; test theme/mobile/consent on staging.

Before updating, back up the database and plugin files and verify a restore on staging. Replace Free, then matching Pro if used, without uninstalling. Old folder? See migration FAQ.

Guide | Support
sections.faq:
What happens when two campaigns qualify?

Free: highest eligible ID wins; editing does not reorder it. Diagnostics explains; Pro adds priorities.

Why is my bar not appearing?

Visibility checks covers publication, dates, rules, dismissal, frequency. Clear caches after updates/Pro activation/deactivation. Public-page discovery loads UI/styles/consent for new/resumed campaigns too. Blocked requests/scripts prevent display. Simulations cannot certify theme/CSS/cache delivery or inspect another visitor.

How do I migrate from the old campaign-bars package?

Back up. In OLD Free Settings, turn OFF Delete plugin data on uninstall; save and verify. Deactivate Pro then old Free. Delete old Free only with that setting off, or remove via SFTP without uninstalling. Install current Free then matching Pro; clear caches, verify data. Never activate both Free packages. Before WordPress 6.9, use the Plugins screen, not programmatic legacy activation. Read migration.txt first.
sections.changelog:
1.2.2

  • Compact optional Pro examples with readable badges, a remembered accessible switch and a separate Explore Pro action.
  • More plugins shows 16 companions with bundled original logos, three relevant recommendations first and responsive cards. No automatic installation or remote catalogue requests.
  • Existing campaigns, settings, permissions, privacy defaults and local Pro functionality are preserved.

1.2.1

  • Fix dbDelta parsing when updating or reinstalling existing report/event tables, without changing the schema or deleting data.
  • Clarify legacy-package migration guidance and add genuine workspace screenshot descriptions.

1.2.0

  • Introduce the responsive sidebar, optional focus workspace and mobile navigation.
  • Add Plugins.shop attribution, hideable illustrative Pro examples, contextual help and the More plugins page.
  • Keep examples separate from real campaigns and preserve draft, conflict, consent, diagnostics and recovery workflows.

1.1.4

  • Maintain compatibility with the matching Pro release’s Licence & updates screen; preserve Free functionality and saved data.

Earlier changes are in changelog.txt.
